brief:
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem announced a festive mass marking the feast of the Guardian Angels, to be presided over by Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa, patriarch of Jerusalem for the Latin church. The patriarchate did not specify a date or venue for the celebration.

The mass will include a thanksgiving service for the apostolic nuncio, the papal diplomatic representative. The patriarchate extended an invitation to the public to attend the liturgical commemoration.
